driver-layers.title: Three layers, one of them yours
driver-layers.alt: Layer diagram: the application calls the hardware-agnostic AS5047U driver, which reads and writes the chip's typed registers in CRC-protected SPI frames through the SpiInterface base class, which calls the transfer() method of the platform port you write, which drives the SPI bus of the AS5047U.
driver-layers.description: From top to bottom. Your application talks to one AS5047U<SpiType> object. Its methods read and write the chip's typed registers (listed from inc/as5047u_registers.hpp), build 16-, 24- or 32-bit frames with CRC, check writes by reading them back and collect the ERRFL error flags. The SPI interface (SpiInterface in inc/as5047u_spi_interface.hpp) is a CRTP base with one method. The platform port is the only code you write: a class whose transfer() moves one frame over SPI with chip select held low and returns false on a bus error. Below it is the hardware.
